newsitem.title: USA: Fed's 5-day fixed system RPs total $6.9 billion.
newsitem.headline: Fed's 5-day fixed system RPs total $6.9 billion.

text.p: The Federal Reserve's addition of reserves via 5-day fixed-system repurchase agreements totaled $6.9 billion on Wednesday, a Fed spokeswoman said.

Detailing the size of its system repurchase agreements operation is part of the Fed's new daily open market operations announced late last year. The Fed revamped its daily intervention procedure to keep pace with stepped-up market activity.
At 1100 EST/1600 GMT, the overnight bank lending, or federal funds rate, stood below the Fed's 5-1/4-percent target rate at 5-3/16 percent.
